fields.meaning: Exact existing action business identity, distinct from generated action:v1 IDs.
Exact source scope token; ALL is retained without expansion into invented system rows.
Reported compliance task text.
Reported task owner; distinct from required reviewer.
Existing operational deadline, never proposed date, approved date, legal effective date or assigned review date.
Planned/open/blocked/scheduled/closed denote operational progression, not approved/compliant/complete.
Review path only: legal -> Legal; operations -> Operations. Not an approval decision.
Exact source version string; newer versions remain syntactically acceptable.
Exact evidence/incident business identity.
Exact referenced system identity; no fuzzy join.
Source-native record category, distinct from internal record_type.
Source report date, not an invented timestamp or observation date.
Reported owner responsible for the record.
Reported operational state; closed does not prove compliance or approval.
Exact source report reference, not proof that the underlying report was read.

Complete: supplied evidence, not compliance; partial: verification incomplete; conflicting: reported evidence/capture contradiction. Missing/stale remain source labels, not automatically adjudicated gaps.
Exact owner/source notes; unresolved contradictions are retained.
Exact system business identity; never derive from position.
Source system name.
Reported actual use; no legal classification inferred.
Reported system owner; not authenticated reviewer identity.
Source role assertion: yes/true, no/false, unknown/null; not verified legal role.
Source role assertion; never default all systems to deployer.
Reported exposed group; preserve exact text rather than guessing a list delimiter.
Reported output category; not a legal applicability determination.
Reported notice state. visible_label is visible disclosure only, never machine-readable provenance; yes alone does not establish timing.
Reported review/escalation path; not evidence of completed review.
Reported evidence state; complete means supplied evidence, not compliance.
Date of reported evidence update; not source revision, legal effective date or retrieval time.
Exact row version string; no fixed date/version whitelist.
